title_hi: Mindfulness और attention: studies क्या मापते हैं?
unique_angle: Mindfulness studies may measure self-report, task-specific attention performance, or EEG/ERP correlates; no single proxy is a complete meter of attention or private experience.
evidence_class: peer-reviewed randomized longitudinal EEG study, review, and multimethod research
safety_boundary: Public education only. No diagnosis, treatment, prescription, individualized meditation plan, guaranteed attention improvement, universal brain-change claim, or mind-reading from EEG, behavior, or self-report.

source_ids.citation: Moore, Gruber, Derose, and Malinowski (2012), Regular, brief mindfulness meditation practice improves electrophysiological markers of attentional control

visual_provenance: Deterministic conceptual motion-graphics scenes showing self-report, task-specific behavior, EEG/ERP correlates, and study-design limitations. No participant likenesses, clinical brain scans, literal mind-reading, or individual prediction.
